questions: What may be the reason that friends are similar to each other, according to the recent research?

They are generally the same age.
Their brains work in harmony.
They have the same ethnic background.

It can work both ways.
It can be touching.
It is hard to predict.

Search for their half-brothers.

They were both 60 years of age.
They were born to the same mother.
They flew 737 airplanes as pilots.
They were both given up for adoption.

The kilometer-long beach was practically deserted.
The beautiful beach was spoiled with lots of trash

One of the five tourists.
A passerby.
